# Tip & bill splitter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/tip/

Add a percentage tip to a bill and divide the total equally among a group. See the tip and full amount before splitting.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Split an NPR 2400 meal three ways with a 10% tip to get NPR 880 per person.

## Limits and checks

The split is equal; different orders or individually assigned charges are not calculated. Rounding can leave a small remainder.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
